summary: Shows file module examples: setting ownership and mode, group by GID, sticky 1777 permissions, symlinks and hard links, touching files idempotently with preserved times, creating directories, setting times, recursive ownership changes, and removing files or directories with state=absent.
questions: How do I create a directory if it doesn't exist?
How do I delete a directory recursively?
How do I touch a file without making the task always changed?
How do I recursively chown a directory?
How do I create hard links in a loop?
How do I set a file's access time from an epoch value?

answer_card.title: file module examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.file:        # create directory
    path: /etc/some_directory
    state: directory
    mode: '0755'

- ansible.builtin.file:        # symlink
    src: /file/to/link/to
    dest: /path/to/symlink
    state: link

- ansible.builtin.file:        # idempotent touch
    path: /etc/foo.conf
    state: touch
    mode: u+rw,g-wx,o-rwx
    modification_time: preserve
    access_time: preserve

- ansible.builtin.file:        # recursive chown
    path: /etc/foo
    state: directory
    recurse: yes
    owner: foo
    group: foo

- ansible.builtin.file:        # delete file or directory (recursively)
    path: /etc/foo
    state: absent
```
Set time from epoch: `access_time: '{{ "%Y%m%d%H%M.%S" | strftime(stat_var.stat.atime) }}'`.
